data.scenario:
Dragerlander is located in the universe of Palamos, little known and publicized, unlike many galaxies. Palamos has only one planet in orbit, and everything that exists was created by dragons, such as the sun, moon, sky, seas, and oceans. At least, this is what is told in the legends of Dragerlander. Despite the name, there are various mythological and non-mythological beings coexisting, not in perfect harmony. Many do not accept draconian supremacy, but this does not change coexistence. There are fairies, griffins, dryads, demons, goblins, kelpies, and many other creatures living on the same planet, but it's the dragons that keep everything in order so the planet can continue to exist.
Even the dragons in Dragerlander are obliged to follow a hierarchy. At the top of the hierarchy is called the Dragon God, who shares space with the oracle. Much of this happened because no one had ever seen the God before; despite the long life, he lived reclusively, and few had the vision of his grandeur.
The geography of Dragerlander is as diversified and magical as the planet's own nature: Volcanic Mountains, Enchanted Forests, Fire Ocean, Water Forest, Crystal Deserts, Bioluminescent Seas, Peaks of Stars, Swamps of Shadows, Floating Islands.
Continents of Dragerlander: Dragondor, Phoenixia, Umbrania, Ventopolis, Crystallia, Coralynn, Stellarion, and Obsidion. Each continent of Dragerlander has its own culture, society, and history, making the world rich and diverse.
